Thank you for the quick response, Greg, very helpful!
On Thu, Feb 15, 2024 at 6:00 AM Greg Kehailia ‹ [opaque block] [contact omitted]> wrote:
Dear Shannon,
Thank you very much for this opportunity to convey the issues reported by our partners.
Our partners explained that for services from companies of the Google's ecosystem, including YouTube, BY is regarded as part of the Russian-language segment of the digital market. Our
the consequences is that it renders impossible to get BY-language or bilingual YouTube content property moderated and promoted.
When content creators submit a BY-language video for boosting/promotion, it is usually declined at the stage of pre-moderation, with the following reason for rejection: "Your language is no
Please see below some illustrative screenshots (some in Russian and some in English) related to the rejection of promotion requests submitted by these five YouTube channels:
• [contact omitted] (BY history)
[contact omitted] music)
• [contact omitted] (Radio Racyja)
[contact omitted] a channel for children)
• [contact omitted] (Nasha Niva, the largest independent media outlet covering BY news in BY language)
Because of that blockage, most of these channels have stopped trying to promote videos on YouTube and shifted their boosting investment to other platforms.
In case you haven't received that paper before, 1 also attach a document developed by Press Club BY regarding issues BY independent media would like to discuss with Big Tech.
I hope this is useful. Please let us know if you need more information.
Best,
Greg
